- Environment Setup:
  - Requires Python 3.9 or higher.
  - Recommended installation via Conda:
    - `conda create -n metagpt python=3.9 && conda activate metagpt`
  - Install the package via pip:
    - `pip install metagpt`
  - Initial configuration setup:
    - `metagpt --init-config` (creates `~/.metagpt/config2.yaml`, user should modify it accordingly)
  - Configuration file example is available at:
    - `~/.metagpt/config2.yaml` (can be based on https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT/blob/main/config/config2.example.yaml)
  - Docker installation steps:
    - Pull latest image:
      - `docker pull metagpt/metagpt:latest`
    - Prepare configuration:
      - `mkdir -p /opt/metagpt/{config,workspace}`
      - `docker run --rm metagpt/metagpt:latest cat /app/metagpt/config/config2.yaml > /opt/metagpt/config/config2.yaml`
      - User edits `/opt/metagpt/config/config2.yaml`
    - Run container:
      ```
      docker run --name metagpt -d \
          --privileged \
          -v /opt/metagpt/config/config2.yaml:/app/metagpt/config/config2.yaml \
          -v /opt/metagpt/workspace:/app/metagpt/workspace \
          metagpt/metagpt:latest
      ```
    - Use container shell and run metagpt commands:
      - `docker exec -it metagpt /bin/bash`
      - Inside container: `metagpt "Create a 2048 game"` (creates project in workspace)
